title: Concept: Requirement pinned with a version wildcard
description: requirements.txt declares an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `==X.*` pin that still admits every matching release.
